ITEM_BLINDNESS.name: Blindness
ITEM_BLINDNESS.flavorText: This slightly poisonous potion temporarily impedes your eyesight, making you unable to see a thing.

ITEM_PARANOIA.name: Paranoia
ITEM_PARANOIA.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will make you scared. You will not be able to hit your enemies in combat if you're scared.

ITEM_CONFUSION.name: Confusion
ITEM_CONFUSION.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will confuse you. You will not be able to cast spells, use wands, staves or scrolls. You can still quaff potions, though.

ITEM_HALLUCINATION.name: Hallucination
ITEM_HALLUCINATION.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will make you hallucinate. You will not be able to recognise any monster or item.

ITEM_CURE_POISON.name: Cure Poison
ITEM_CURE_POISON.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will cure you from poison.

ITEM_CURE_BLINDNESS.name: Cure Blindness
ITEM_CURE_BLINDNESS.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will cure you from blindness.

ITEM_CURE_PARANOIA.name: Cure Paranoia
ITEM_CURE_PARANOIA.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will cure your paranoia.  Paranoia is the state when you are too afraid to attack monsters.

ITEM_CURE_CONFUSION.name: Cure Confusion
ITEM_CURE_CONFUSION.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will cure your confusion.  Confusion is when you are too confused to cast spells, zap staves, aim wands or read scrolls.

ITEM_WEAKNESS.name: Weakness
ITEM_WEAKNESS.flavorText: This nasty potion will sap your strength, making you weaker.

ITEM_UNHEALTH.name: Unhealth
ITEM_UNHEALTH.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will reduce your constitution by one point.

ITEM_RESTORE_CONSTITUTION.name: Restore Constitution
ITEM_RESTORE_CONSTITUTION.flavorText: A beneficial magical concoction, restoring your damaged health.

ITEM_RESTORING.name: Restoring
ITEM_RESTORING.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will restore your strength, dexterity, constitution, intelligence, wisdom and charisma. These need restoring when they are displayed in yellow.

ITEM_STUPIDITY.name: Stupidity
ITEM_STUPIDITY.flavorText: This accursed potion will cloud your intellect, making you stupid.

ITEM_NAIVETY.name: Naivety
ITEM_NAIVETY.flavorText: This potion casts a shadow on your knowledge, making you foolish.

ITEM_POISON.name: Poison
ITEM_POISON.flavorText: This bottle is filled with a mild but still dangerous liquid poison. Drinking it would be highly unwise.

ITEM_SICKNESS.name: Sickness
ITEM_SICKNESS.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will reduce your constitution by one point. It will also damage you quite severely in the process. That's a bad thing.

ITEM_PARALYSIS.name: Paralysis
ITEM_PARALYSIS.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will paralyse you for a certain time. Any nearby monsters will take this opportunity to kill you. That's a bad thing.

ITEM_RESTORE_STRENGTH.name: Restore Strength
ITEM_RESTORE_STRENGTH.flavorText: This magical potion will bring back your physical power to its full extent, should it be drained.

ITEM_DISEASE.name: Disease
ITEM_DISEASE.flavorText: 'E'ating this mushroom will reduce your strength by one point. It will also damage you quite severely in the process. That's a bad thing.

ITEM_CURE_SERIOUS_WOUNDS.name: Cure Serious Wounds
ITEM_CURE_SERIOUS_WOUNDS.flavorText: This beneficial potion will cure some wounds and other inhibiting ailments.

ITEM_RATION_OF_FOOD.name: & Ration~ of Food
ITEM_RATION_OF_FOOD.flavorText: Lightweight and filling. Not an incredible taste experience, but that'd be asking a bit much. You can 'E'at it.

ITEM_HARD_BISCUIT.name: & Hard Biscuit~
ITEM_HARD_BISCUIT.flavorText: It doesn't look great, and 'E'ating it will only fill your stomach a bit, for a short time.

ITEM_STRIP_OF_VENISON.name: & Strip~ of Venison
ITEM_STRIP_OF_VENISON.flavorText: It looks great, and 'E'ating it will fill your stomach well.

ITEM_SLIME_MOLD.name: & Slime Mold~
ITEM_SLIME_MOLD.flavorText: It looks disgusting, but if you really want to you can 'E'at it. Not an incredible taste experience, but that'd be asking a bit much.

ITEM_PINT_OF_FINE_ALE.name: & Pint~ of Fine Ale
ITEM_PINT_OF_FINE_ALE.flavorText: A bottle of a dark beer-like beverage. You can drink it by pressing 'E'.

ITEM_PINT_OF_FINE_WINE.name: & Pint~ of Fine Wine
ITEM_PINT_OF_FINE_WINE.flavorText: A bottle of fine wine. You can drink it by pressing 'E'.

ITEM_MATTOCK.name: & Mattock~
ITEM_MATTOCK.flavorText: This is a digging tool. Use it to dig in walls, destroy doors, or cut wood.

ITEM_BLUE_STONE.name: & Blue Stone~
ITEM_BLUE_STONE.flavorText: A standard & Blue Stone~ from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_BROKEN_DAGGER.name: & Broken Dagger~
ITEM_BROKEN_DAGGER.flavorText: The blade itself is a foot long and broken off not far above the hilt.

ITEM_BASTARD_SWORD.name: & Bastard Sword~
ITEM_BASTARD_SWORD.flavorText: This is a long, double-edged sword with a plain hilt that could be wielded in one or two hands. It's called a "bastard sword" because in size, it falls between the broad sword and the two-handed sword, thus not having a family of its own. It's typically around 51 inches long. It is effective for cutting through tougher armours. It could be used for thrusting, but most wielders swing it like a bat.

ITEM_SCIMITAR.name: & Scimitar~
ITEM_SCIMITAR.flavorText: This oriental blade has 2 edges and is deeply curved. It has a wide and very sharp end. It is the forefather of the sabre.

ITEM_TULWAR.name: & Tulwar~
ITEM_TULWAR.flavorText: This vicious sword is half sword and half club, with a slight hook on the tip.

ITEM_BROAD_SWORD.name: & Broad Sword~
ITEM_BROAD_SWORD.flavorText: This broader version of the long sword is a standard weapon in the army of Gondolin.

ITEM_SHORT_SWORD.name: & Short Sword~
ITEM_SHORT_SWORD.flavorText: This shorter version of the long sword is a common weapon for rogues and mages.

ITEM_BLADE_OF_CHAOS.name: & Blade~ of Chaos
ITEM_BLADE_OF_CHAOS.flavorText: A mighty sword which seems to be completely blunt. However, it is a conduit into the realms of pure chaos and strikes its victims with the devastating might of chaos itself whenever it connects. It gives you resistance to chaos and it can polymorph, teleport, confuse or drain hit points from the monster you hit. It occasionally causes earthquakes as well.

ITEM_TWO_HANDED_SWORD.name: & Two-Handed Sword~
ITEM_TWO_HANDED_SWORD.flavorText: This blade is lot longer, wider and heavier than a long sword. You have to wield it with two hands. This means that wielding a shield makes fighting very difficult.

ITEM_MAIN_GAUCHE.name: & Main Gauche~
ITEM_MAIN_GAUCHE.flavorText: This blade is sinuously curved and tipped with a harpoon-like end. This blade has a large handguard and was designed as an off-hand weapon. This short but cruel blade is a favourite among orcs.

ITEM_CUTLASS.name: & Cutlass~
ITEM_CUTLASS.flavorText: This oriental weapon is a short, thick, curving sword with a single cutting edge. This simple slashing weapon is typically carried by buccaneers, pirates, and sailors.

ITEM_EXECUTIONER_S_SWORD.name: & Executioner's Sword~
ITEM_EXECUTIONER_S_SWORD.flavorText: These weapons have been built in all sizes. They are custom-made for warriors that want to set out and kill their archenemy. These blades are rare, costly and very deadly.

ITEM_KATANA.name: & Katana~
ITEM_KATANA.flavorText: The katana is a long blade with only a small disk for a guard. Its hilt is long enough for two hands, though it could be used with only one hand, and is usually wrapped in cloth or leather. The art of forging such swords is largely unknown in this part of Middle-earth, and such weapons are typically imported from distant lands.

ITEM_LONG_SWORD.name: & Long Sword~
ITEM_LONG_SWORD.flavorText: A long straight sword, tapering to a pronounced point. Mainly good for piercing attacks, but it can be used for slashing, too. It is a very popular design and has become standard issue in many armies.

ITEM_DAGGER.name: & Dagger~
ITEM_DAGGER.flavorText: It's the standard weapon of rogues and thieves.  The blade is a foot long.

ITEM_RAPIER.name: & Rapier~
ITEM_RAPIER.flavorText: The rapier's hilt consisted of a pair of oval guards pierced with holes, recurved quillions, and a knuckle guard.  The guard is very intricate and very effective as protection.

ITEM_SABRE.name: & Sabre~
ITEM_SABRE.flavorText: A long, one-edged, slightly curved sword with a knuckle guard and short hilt.  It is two-edged in its lower part.

ITEM_SMALL_SWORD.name: & Small Sword~
ITEM_SMALL_SWORD.flavorText: It's the favourite weapon of strong mages and thieves. The blade is about twenty inches long. It's very easy to handle, although it is a lot less efficient than the longer and heavier designs.

ITEM_BROKEN_SWORD.name: & Broken Sword~
ITEM_BROKEN_SWORD.flavorText: Just a hilt and a few inches of blade, broken off in a jagged stump. Probably worthless.

ITEM_BALL_AND_CHAIN.name: & Ball-and-Chain~
ITEM_BALL_AND_CHAIN.flavorText: This weapon has a ball linked with a chain to a wooden handle. Preferred tactic is smashing the brains of your opponent.

ITEM_WHIP.name: & Whip~
ITEM_WHIP.flavorText: Think Doctor Jones. This weapon is light and easy to fight with. It has nasty barbs and hooks fixed to the thong to make it useful in combat. Whips give easily multiple attacks.

ITEM_FLAIL.name: & Flail~
ITEM_FLAIL.flavorText: This weapon was originally used to cut corn. More warlike versions sport a large blade stuck on a wooden handle. The hinge allows it to get past enemy defences or to strike with added momentum when used skillfully.

ITEM_TWO_HANDED_FLAIL.name: & Two-Handed Flail~
ITEM_TWO_HANDED_FLAIL.flavorText: This two-handed version of the flail gives the fighter a fearsome weapon that can do a fair amount of damage.  It typically has several spiked metal lumps on chains.

ITEM_MORNING_STAR.name: & Morning Star~
ITEM_MORNING_STAR.flavorText: This weapon consists of a large club with chains that have wooden balls with metal spikes on the end.

ITEM_MACE.name: & Mace~
ITEM_MACE.flavorText: This weapon is a club ending in a sphere. The sphere is studded with metal shards, and thus can both crush and cut your adversary.

ITEM_QUARTERSTAFF.name: & Quarterstaff~
ITEM_QUARTERSTAFF.flavorText: A long, wooden pole, usually the height of the wielder. Four of them can be made out of the trunk of one young tree, hence the name. The quarterstaff is an excellent weapon for travellers as it doubles both as a walking staff and as a deterrent against brigands. The quarterstaff is used more in fencing and brawling than melee combat.

ITEM_WAR_HAMMER.name: & War Hammer~
ITEM_WAR_HAMMER.flavorText: A large hammer, designed to crush skulls with mighty strikes.

ITEM_LEAD_FILLED_MACE.name: & Lead-Filled Mace~
ITEM_LEAD_FILLED_MACE.flavorText: A large, mean mace filled with lead in order to wreak a maximum of havoc.

ITEM_MACE_OF_DISRUPTION.name: & Mace~ of Disruption
ITEM_MACE_OF_DISRUPTION.flavorText: This mace is custom-made for priests that go out to destroy evil. It is deadly, especially for undead.

ITEM_LUCERNE_HAMMER.name: & Lucerne Hammer~
ITEM_LUCERNE_HAMMER.flavorText: A war hammer combined with a spearpoint, mounted on a long pole.

ITEM_BEAKED_AXE.name: & Beaked Axe~
ITEM_BEAKED_AXE.flavorText: This polearm has a beak mounted opposite the blade.

ITEM_GLAIVE.name: & Glaive~
ITEM_GLAIVE.flavorText: A polearm with a long, slightly curved knife-like blade. It has spurs on the dull side of the blade. It's primarily a slashing and chopping weapon. Glaives are often used to protect archers, crossbowmen, and gunners while they reload. Outside of combat they are a popular processional weapon and therefore many have ornately carved blades.

ITEM_HALBERD.name: & Halberd~
ITEM_HALBERD.flavorText: The halberd has a broad, short axe blade on a 5 - 6ft long haft, with a spearpoint at the top, often a back-spike and occasionally a butt-spike. Used to combat heavier armour. It's usually used for cutting and stabbing.  It's the most versatile polearm in Middle-earth. The axe is used in general melee. The top pike is used to pierce armour, or is set against a cavalry charge. The back hook could unseat horses, trip opponents, parry a blow, or be a general piercing weapon.

ITEM_AWL_PIKE.name: & Awl-Pike~
ITEM_AWL_PIKE.flavorText: This is a polearm with a long square-sectioned spike on the end.

ITEM_PIKE.name: & Pike~
ITEM_PIKE.flavorText: A staff, 16-18 feet long, that has a small piercing head about 10 inches long. The pike is often used by infantry to fend off cavalry.  It is very effective against mounted troops.

ITEM_SPEAR.name: & Spear~
ITEM_SPEAR.flavorText: Spears tend to have a strong, wide, leaf-shaped head with a ridge down the middle. The spearhead is attached to the wooden shaft by a socket. The sockets are usually riveted to the shaft and some have two small lugs near the base of the socket to allow the head to be possibly bound on as well. This spear is 7 feet long.

ITEM_TRIDENT.name: & Trident~
ITEM_TRIDENT.flavorText: The trident is based on the pitchfork.  In fact, when not used as a weapon, it is often employed as a pitchfork. It is famous for its uses in gladiatorial arenas. It is used much like a spear and could even be thrown like one in desperate situations.

ITEM_LANCE.name: & Lance~
ITEM_LANCE.flavorText: This is the original polearm. It is shaped like a spear but is bigger. It's meant to fend off enemies, not to be thrown.

ITEM_GREAT_AXE.name: & Great Axe~
ITEM_GREAT_AXE.flavorText: A huge and heavy two-headed axe.

ITEM_BATTLE_AXE.name: & Battle Axe~
ITEM_BATTLE_AXE.flavorText: Nordic polearm with a broad blade and a hook mounted on the end of the shaft. The Nordics' take on the halberd. The polearm of choice for many Nordics, ideally suited for slashing, thrusting, and unseating cavalry.

ITEM_LOCHABER_AXE.name: & Lochaber Axe~
ITEM_LOCHABER_AXE.flavorText: Nordic polearm with a broad blade and a hook mounted on the end of the shaft. A Nordic version of the halberd. The polearm of choice for many Nordics, this weapon is ideally suited for slashing, thrusting, and unseating cavalry.

ITEM_BROAD_AXE.name: & Broad Axe~
ITEM_BROAD_AXE.flavorText: A one-headed axe made for combat, with an elongated moon-shaped blade.

ITEM_SCYTHE.name: & Scythe~
ITEM_SCYTHE.flavorText: A simple farm implement, converted into a weapon by slightly straightening its blade and putting it in line with its pole, instead of the typical right angle.

ITEM_SCYTHE_OF_SLICING.name: & Scythe~ of Slicing
ITEM_SCYTHE_OF_SLICING.flavorText: The simple design of the war scythe, but this one uses a finely crafted and incredibly sharp steel blade which causes terrible wounds when it hits.

ITEM_SHORT_BOW.name: & Short Bow~
ITEM_SHORT_BOW.flavorText: A piece of bent wood, fitted with a string. Easy to transport and use, but its effect is not very impressive. You can 'f'ire it after you 'w'ield it.

ITEM_LONG_BOW.name: & Long Bow~
ITEM_LONG_BOW.flavorText: A bow almost as long as a human. It takes considerable strength and skill to use and is rather awkward to carry around inside buildings. Nevertheless, it shoots arrows with astonishing force. You can 'f'ire it after you 'w'ield it.

ITEM_LIGHT_CROSSBOW.name: & Light Crossbow~
ITEM_LIGHT_CROSSBOW.flavorText: A metal bow mounted on a wooden stock. It is used for shooting bolts. This design is relatively light and not too difficult to cock, but also shoots its quarrels with less force. You can 'f'ire with it after you 'w'ield it.

ITEM_HEAVY_CROSSBOW.name: & Heavy Crossbow~
ITEM_HEAVY_CROSSBOW.flavorText: A metal bow mounted on a wooden stock, with attached cocking mechanism. It takes considerable time and strength to cock it and it's rather heavy. However, it hurls its ammunition with incredible force. You can 'f'ire with it after you 'w'ield it.

ITEM_SLING.name: & Sling~
ITEM_SLING.flavorText: A simple cloth or leather pouch with two strings attached. It is used to hurl pebbles or iron shots. You can 'f'ire with it after you 'w'ield it.

ITEM_ARROW.name: & Arrow~
ITEM_ARROW.flavorText: A simple metal head on a piece of wood or bamboo, fitted with some feathers. You can use it for 'f'iring a bow.

ITEM_SEEKER_ARROW.name: & Seeker Arrow~
ITEM_SEEKER_ARROW.flavorText: A precision-made arrow, which allows you to hit precisely the most vulnerable place of an opponent. You can use it for 'f'iring a bow.

ITEM_BOLT.name: & Bolt~
ITEM_BOLT.flavorText: A short metal arrow, to be 'f'ired with a crossbow.

ITEM_SEEKER_BOLT.name: & Seeker Bolt~
ITEM_SEEKER_BOLT.flavorText: A precision-made bolt, which allows you to hit exactly the most vulnerable place of an opponent. You can use it for 'f'iring a crossbow.

ITEM_ROUNDED_PEBBLE.name: & Rounded Pebble~
ITEM_ROUNDED_PEBBLE.flavorText: Small round stones. When fired with a sling, they could even hurt a giant. You can use them for 'f'iring a sling.

ITEM_IRON_SHOT.name: & Iron Shot~
ITEM_IRON_SHOT.flavorText: Metal balls, made for shooting with slings. You can use them for 'f'iring a sling.

ITEM_SHOVEL.name: & Shovel~
ITEM_SHOVEL.flavorText: A simple digging tool for shovelling away rubble and maybe even soft rock.

ITEM_GNOMISH_SHOVEL.name: & Gnomish Shovel~
ITEM_GNOMISH_SHOVEL.flavorText: Crafted by the gnomes, its design profits greatly from the gnomes' expertise honed in the burrowing of their hovels.

ITEM_DWARVEN_SHOVEL.name: & Dwarven Shovel~
ITEM_DWARVEN_SHOVEL.flavorText: The lighter digging tool used by dwarves to remove debris, but also good enough to clear away bits of rock when no pick is easily available.

ITEM_PICK.name: & Pick~
ITEM_PICK.flavorText: A heavy digging tool, primarily for earthworking, but also good for tunnelling through stone, if one is willing to perform the time-consuming labour.

ITEM_ORCISH_PICK.name: & Orcish Pick~
ITEM_ORCISH_PICK.flavorText: Although orcs tend to dig rather untidy mines and overcome difficulties in this work less by skill than mere stubbornness, they have amassed quite some expertise in mining, which has gone into this digging tool.

ITEM_DWARVEN_PICK.name: & Dwarven Pick~
ITEM_DWARVEN_PICK.flavorText: The dwarves, miners of legend, have made this pick, which is so expertly crafted that even weaklings can bore through solid rock with it.

ITEM_ELVEN_CLOAK.name: & Elven Cloak~
ITEM_ELVEN_CLOAK.flavorText: A wonderfully light cloak coloured in brown and green hues. Its colouring greatly helps the wearer to avoid undesired attention. Wearing it makes you feel lucky and somehow you seem to see what was meant to stay unseen.

ITEM_PAIR_OF_SOFT_LEATHER_BOOTS.name: & Pair~ of Soft Leather Boots
ITEM_PAIR_OF_SOFT_LEATHER_BOOTS.flavorText: A pair of low boots, comfortable to wear.

ITEM_PAIR_OF_HARD_LEATHER_BOOTS.name: & Pair~ of Hard Leather Boots
ITEM_PAIR_OF_HARD_LEATHER_BOOTS.flavorText: A pair of boots, with hardened leather at the caps, offering a little extra protection for the feet.

ITEM_PAIR_OF_METAL_SHOD_BOOTS.name: & Pair~ of Metal Shod Boots
ITEM_PAIR_OF_METAL_SHOD_BOOTS.flavorText: Heavy boots, with metal strips at the toes, heels and other vulnerable parts, to better protect the wearer's feet from harm.

ITEM_HARD_LEATHER_CAP.name: & Hard Leather Cap~
ITEM_HARD_LEATHER_CAP.flavorText: A piece of protective headgear made from hardened leather, just covering the skull.

ITEM_METAL_CAP.name: & Metal Cap~
ITEM_METAL_CAP.flavorText: A metal skullcap with nose and cheekguards.

ITEM_IRON_HELM.name: & Iron Helm~
ITEM_IRON_HELM.flavorText: A large helmet that can protect the entire head. Ventilation and bad vision can be a problem, however.

ITEM_STEEL_HELM.name: & Steel Helm~
ITEM_STEEL_HELM.flavorText: A helmet which protects the entire head. The expensive steel as base material allows it to offer very good protection while being fairly light.

ITEM_IRON_CROWN.name: & Iron Crown~
ITEM_IRON_CROWN.flavorText: An iron circlet which might be worn, but which is purely ornamental unless it has special powers.

ITEM_GOLDEN_CROWN.name: & Golden Crown~
ITEM_GOLDEN_CROWN.flavorText: A gilded crown, which just looks good. Sometimes such headgear also has additional properties which might make it worth wearing.

ITEM_JEWEL_ENCRUSTED_CROWN.name: & Jewel Encrusted Crown~
ITEM_JEWEL_ENCRUSTED_CROWN.flavorText: A gorgeous-looking silver crown, adorned with several gems. You might wear it on your head, if you really think you're worthy.

ITEM_ROBE.name: & Robe~
ITEM_ROBE.flavorText: A full-length garment which can be worn on the body. It is not really armour, but mages often wear them as they are very light and don't hinder movement much.

ITEM_FILTHY_RAG.name: & Filthy Rag~
ITEM_FILTHY_RAG.flavorText: A piece of discarded cloth, smelly and dirty. Eurgh. You're not going to wear this, are you?

ITEM_SOFT_LEATHER_ARMOUR.name: & Soft Leather Armour~
ITEM_SOFT_LEATHER_ARMOUR.flavorText: A leather jerkin, light and unencumbering, but not very protective.

ITEM_SOFT_STUDDED_LEATHER.name: & Soft Studded Leather~
ITEM_SOFT_STUDDED_LEATHER.flavorText: A leather jerkin with metal studs in critical places offering slightly better protection.

ITEM_HARD_LEATHER_ARMOUR.name: & Hard Leather Armour~
ITEM_HARD_LEATHER_ARMOUR.flavorText: A leather armour covering only the body. It is made of hardened leather to make it harder to penetrate.  It's also a bit harder to move in, as it is rather stiff.

ITEM_HARD_STUDDED_LEATHER.name: & Hard Studded Leather~
ITEM_HARD_STUDDED_LEATHER.flavorText: A suit of hardened leather armour, reinforced with metal studs.

ITEM_LEATHER_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Leather Scale Mail~
ITEM_LEATHER_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of armour made of overlapping hardened leather scales. It offers good protection while still being rather lightweight.

ITEM_METAL_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Metal Scale Mail~
ITEM_METAL_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of overlapping metal scales, sewn onto a leather or cloth jerkin.

ITEM_CHAIN_MAIL.name: & Chain Mail~
ITEM_CHAIN_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of interlinked metal rings, to be worn over a woollen garment.

ITEM_RUSTY_CHAIN_MAIL.name: & Rusty Chain Mail~
ITEM_RUSTY_CHAIN_MAIL.flavorText: This chain mail has rusted beyond repair. It can still be worn, but some of the rings have gone missing and the rust has made the suit inflexible. Consequently, it offers very poor protection and is cumbersome to move in.

ITEM_AUGMENTED_CHAIN_MAIL.name: & Augmented Chain Mail~
ITEM_AUGMENTED_CHAIN_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of interlinked metal rings, with additional metal plates or scales covering vulnerable parts of the wearer.

ITEM_BAR_CHAIN_MAIL.name: & Bar Chain Mail~
ITEM_BAR_CHAIN_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of interlinked metal rings, with additional short metal bars added in many places to prevent penetration of the armour by piercing attacks.

ITEM_METAL_BRIGANDINE_ARMOUR.name: & Metal Brigandine Armour~
ITEM_METAL_BRIGANDINE_ARMOUR.flavorText: This is a leather armour with many small metal plates fixed to it, covering it entirely.

ITEM_PARTIAL_PLATE_ARMOUR.name: & Partial Plate Armour~
ITEM_PARTIAL_PLATE_ARMOUR.flavorText: An armour made of steel plates, covering only the body of the wearer.

ITEM_METAL_LAMELLAR_ARMOUR.name: & Metal Lamellar Armour~
ITEM_METAL_LAMELLAR_ARMOUR.flavorText: Lamellar consists of small rectangular plates (lames) attached to each other at each edge or corner with leather lacings through small holes in the plates.

ITEM_FULL_PLATE_ARMOUR.name: & Full Plate Armour~
ITEM_FULL_PLATE_ARMOUR.flavorText: A suit of armour made of metal plates, covering the body, arms and upper legs. A very effective but very heavy armour.

ITEM_RIBBED_PLATE_ARMOUR.name: & Ribbed Plate Armour~
ITEM_RIBBED_PLATE_ARMOUR.flavorText: This full suit of armour has been strengthened in places to better deflect or absorb blows.

ITEM_ADAMANTITE_PLATE_MAIL.name: & Adamantite Plate Mail~
ITEM_ADAMANTITE_PLATE_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of plate armour fashioned from an unbreakable crystal by mage-smiths.

ITEM_MITHRIL_PLATE_MAIL.name: & Mithril Plate Mail~
ITEM_MITHRIL_PLATE_MAIL.flavorText: A full suit of plate armour, fashioned from the rare true-silver. Only the dwarves know the secret of making armour or weapons of this metal.

ITEM_MITHRIL_CHAIN_MAIL.name: & Mithril Chain Mail~
ITEM_MITHRIL_CHAIN_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of chain mail, made by dwarven smiths from the rare and precious metal also called true-silver.

ITEM_DOUBLE_CHAIN_MAIL.name: & Double Chain Mail~
ITEM_DOUBLE_CHAIN_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of chain mail, with an additional layer of mail in some places.

ITEM_SHIELD_OF_DEFLECTION.name: & Shield~ of Deflection
ITEM_SHIELD_OF_DEFLECTION.flavorText: A large shield fashioned from a metal alloy that is not subject to corrosion. It was especially crafted to better deflect attacks.

ITEM_CLOAK.name: & Cloak~
ITEM_CLOAK.flavorText: A cloth coat typically worn as a loose outer garment. It is spacious enough to be worn even over bulky metal armour.

ITEM_SHADOW_CLOAK.name: & Shadow Cloak~
ITEM_SHADOW_CLOAK.flavorText: A rare cloak imbued with magic to radiate a strange twilight, absorbing both extreme brightness and darkness.

ITEM_SET_OF_LEATHER_GLOVES.name: & Set~ of Leather Gloves
ITEM_SET_OF_LEATHER_GLOVES.flavorText: Light gloves which do not seriously hinder finger movements, while still protecting the hands somewhat.

ITEM_SET_OF_GAUNTLETS.name: & Set~ of Gauntlets
ITEM_SET_OF_GAUNTLETS.flavorText: Metal gloves protecting the hands up to the middle of the lower arm.

ITEM_SET_OF_CESTI.name: & Set~ of Cesti
ITEM_SET_OF_CESTI.flavorText: A set of metal gloves with nasty spikes and barbs. Though originally made to help in combat, the additional metal on the backs of the hands also offers a lot more protection.

ITEM_SMALL_LEATHER_SHIELD.name: & Small Leather Shield~
ITEM_SMALL_LEATHER_SHIELD.flavorText: A small disc of lindenwood, with a leather covering on one side.

ITEM_LARGE_LEATHER_SHIELD.name: & Large Leather Shield~
ITEM_LARGE_LEATHER_SHIELD.flavorText: A large oval or rectangular shield. It is made of wood, typically linden, and covered with a layer of hardened leather to offer better protection.

ITEM_SMALL_METAL_SHIELD.name: & Small Metal Shield~
ITEM_SMALL_METAL_SHIELD.flavorText: A small shield strengthened with a layer of metal.

ITEM_LARGE_METAL_SHIELD.name: & Large Metal Shield~
ITEM_LARGE_METAL_SHIELD.flavorText: A large piece of wood, rectangular or oval in shape, and covered with metal to strengthen it. It's to be worn strapped to the arm not occupied by the weapon when fighting.

ITEM_STRENGTH.name: Strength
ITEM_STRENGTH.flavorText: This beneficial potion will magically improve your physical strength.

ITEM_DEXTERITY.name: Dexterity
ITEM_DEXTERITY.flavorText: A strange magical drink which greatly improves your agility and nimbleness.

ITEM_CONSTITUTION.name: Constitution
ITEM_CONSTITUTION.flavorText: This magical concoction greatly improves your health, making you permanently tougher.

ITEM_INTELLIGENCE.name: Intelligence
ITEM_INTELLIGENCE.flavorText: This nice potion will magically enhance your wit, permanently improving your intellect.

ITEM_SPEED.name: Speed
ITEM_SPEED.flavorText: This energising rod will allow you to act a lot faster for some time.

ITEM_SLOW_DIGESTION.name: Slow Digestion
ITEM_SLOW_DIGESTION.flavorText: This talisman will make you hungry less quickly when worn.

ITEM_FIRE_RESISTANCE.name: Fire Resistance
ITEM_FIRE_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This piece of jewellery grants you some protection from the burning heat of fire.

ITEM_COLD_RESISTANCE.name: Cold Resistance
ITEM_COLD_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This piece of jewellery grants you some protection from the chilling forces of cold.

ITEM_LEVITATION.name: Levitation
ITEM_LEVITATION.flavorText: When you put on this ring, you will be able to float just above the floor. It prevents you from drowning, and all your falls will be painless.

ITEM_POISON_RESISTANCE.name: Poison Resistance
ITEM_POISON_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This magical ring grants protection from poison. It is rumoured that in deep dungeons monsters can kill you at once if you don't have poison resistance.

ITEM_FREE_ACTION.name: Free Action
ITEM_FREE_ACTION.flavorText: This magical bauble prevents you from being held. Some monsters will paralyse you and then kill you if you lack free action.

ITEM_FLAMES.name: Flames
ITEM_FLAMES.flavorText: This fiery circlet grants you protection, makes fire less dangerous and even allows you to call forth a ball of flame.

ITEM_ACID.name: Acid
ITEM_ACID.flavorText: This magical ring is imbued with spells of devouring acid, granting protection against such assaults and the ability to shoot acid at your foes.

ITEM_ICE.name: Ice
ITEM_ICE.flavorText: A piece of paper inscribed with light-blue runes that radiate a strange cold. Upon reading them, a large icy blast will be released.

ITEM_WOE.name: Woe
ITEM_WOE.flavorText: This accursed ring will turn you into a bumbling fool and, in addition, magically transports you to places you never wanted to see. It can recurse itself if you leave it on too long.

ITEM_DAMAGE.name: Damage
ITEM_DAMAGE.flavorText: This ring makes your hands magically strong in combat, allowing you to inflict greater pain with your hand-to-hand attacks.

ITEM_ACCURACY.name: Accuracy
ITEM_ACCURACY.flavorText: This ring magically improves your control in combat, allowing you to hit more often.

ITEM_PROTECTION.name: Protection
ITEM_PROTECTION.flavorText: This ring creates a magical aura around you, protecting you against the blows of your enemies.

ITEM_AGGRAVATE_MONSTER.name: Aggravate Monster
ITEM_AGGRAVATE_MONSTER.flavorText: This nasty scroll will make a loud noise, waking up foes in your vicinity.

ITEM_SEE_INVISIBLE.name: See Invisible
ITEM_SEE_INVISIBLE.flavorText: This magical piece of jewellery allows your eyes to perceive beings otherwise unseen.

ITEM_SUSTAIN_STRENGTH.name: Sustain Strength
ITEM_SUSTAIN_STRENGTH.flavorText: This magical bauble protects your physical force against attacks attempting to drain it.

ITEM_SUSTAIN_INTELLIGENCE.name: Sustain Intelligence
ITEM_SUSTAIN_INTELLIGENCE.flavorText: This magical ring protects your intellect against attempts to lower it.

ITEM_SUSTAIN_WISDOM.name: Sustain Wisdom
ITEM_SUSTAIN_WISDOM.flavorText: This magical ring protects you from attempts to make you more foolish.

ITEM_SUSTAIN_CONSTITUTION.name: Sustain Constitution
ITEM_SUSTAIN_CONSTITUTION.flavorText: This magical ring protects your health, making it impossible for your opponents to lower it.

ITEM_SUSTAIN_DEXTERITY.name: Sustain Dexterity
ITEM_SUSTAIN_DEXTERITY.flavorText: This magical ring protects your nerves, so that you will never become clumsy.

ITEM_SUSTAIN_CHARISMA.name: Sustain Charisma
ITEM_SUSTAIN_CHARISMA.flavorText: This ring magically protects your beauty and charm from attempts to make you ugly.

ITEM_SLAYING.name: Slaying
ITEM_SLAYING.flavorText: This ring magically improves your fighting prowess, allowing to hit more often and harder.

ITEM_BRILLIANCE.name: Brilliance
ITEM_BRILLIANCE.flavorText: This talisman grants a sharper wit, greater insight and brightness to light dark places.

ITEM_CHARISMA.name: Charisma
ITEM_CHARISMA.flavorText: This potion infuses you with beauty and charm.

ITEM_TELEPORTATION.name: Teleportation
ITEM_TELEPORTATION.flavorText: A standard Teleportation from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_ACID_RESISTANCE.name: Acid Resistance
ITEM_ACID_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This magical talisman will make the corroding forces of acid less threatening to your health.

ITEM_DOUBLE_RING_MAIL.name: & Double Ring Mail~
ITEM_DOUBLE_RING_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of leather armour with metal rings sewn onto it. In addition, in important parts it is reinforced with mail.

ITEM_THE_MAGI.name: the Magi
ITEM_THE_MAGI.flavorText: This rare amulet is highly desirable for mages, as it makes its wearer smarter, more attentive and impervious to magics which would make their own magic-use impossible.

ITEM_DOOM.name: Doom
ITEM_DOOM.flavorText: This wicked amulet will drain all your abilities, turning you into a mere shadow of yourself. It is exceedingly hard to get rid of.

ITEM_ENCHANT_WEAPON_TO_HIT.name: Enchant Weapon To-Hit
ITEM_ENCHANT_WEAPON_TO_HIT.flavorText: This magical scroll will allow you to improve the accuracy of a weapon in your possession. However, weapons which are already very highly enchanted are more difficult to improve further.

ITEM_ENCHANT_WEAPON_TO_DAM.name: Enchant Weapon To-Dam
ITEM_ENCHANT_WEAPON_TO_DAM.flavorText: Upon reading this scroll, a magical enchantment will be placed on a weapon in your possession, increasing the pain it inflicts when hitting. On very highly enchanted weapons this enchantment may fail, wasting the scroll.

ITEM_ENCHANT_ARMOUR.name: *Enchant Armour*
ITEM_ENCHANT_ARMOUR.flavorText: This scroll will place a great enchantment on a piece of armour of your choice, making it much better at protecting you. Mark that improving armours which are already highly enchanted is very difficult and will often fail.

ITEM_RUMOUR.name: Rumour
ITEM_RUMOUR.flavorText: A piece of paper inscribed with a little text. You may meditate over it or ignore it at your leisure.

ITEM_CHAOS.name: Chaos
ITEM_CHAOS.flavorText: A piece of paper inscribed with strange shifting runes. Upon reading them, they will release a blast of chaotic forces.

ITEM_REMOVE_CURSE.name: *Remove Curse*
ITEM_REMOVE_CURSE.flavorText: This valuable scroll is inscribed with a powerful blessing capable of dispelling all but the mightiest curses which may have been laid on your possessions.

ITEM_LIGHT.name: Light
ITEM_LIGHT.flavorText: This rod can shoot a lance of bright light, hurting creatures which lurk in the dark.

ITEM_FIRE.name: [Fire]
ITEM_FIRE.flavorText: A bright red crystal, filled with a liquid flame that scorches you even though the surface of the gem is cool to the touch.

ITEM_SUMMON_MONSTERS.name: Summon Monsters
ITEM_SUMMON_MONSTERS.flavorText: This scroll was made by mischievous sorcerers. If it is read, a few creatures will appear to fight you.

ITEM_PHASE_DOOR.name: Phase Door
ITEM_PHASE_DOOR.flavorText: Upon reading this scroll, you will be translocated over a short distance.

ITEM_TELEPORT_LEVEL.name: Teleport Level
ITEM_TELEPORT_LEVEL.flavorText: This scroll will magically transport you to the level directly above or below, when read.

ITEM_MONSTER_CONFUSION.name: Monster Confusion
ITEM_MONSTER_CONFUSION.flavorText: Reading this scroll will cause your hands to glow with a strange mesmerising light that will attempt to confuse the next creature you hit with a hand or weapon attack.

ITEM_MAGIC_MAPPING.name: Magic Mapping
ITEM_MAGIC_MAPPING.flavorText: Reading this scroll will reveal the layout of your immediate surroundings to you.

ITEM_RUNE_OF_PROTECTION.name: Rune of Protection
ITEM_RUNE_OF_PROTECTION.flavorText: This scroll is inscribed with a powerful protective incantation. When read, this will erect a strong magical ward around the location you currently stand on. Be aware that this magic is easily disturbed by already present structures and thus cannot work where an object is lying, or on a trap.

ITEM_TREASURE_DETECTION.name: Treasure Detection
ITEM_TREASURE_DETECTION.flavorText: This scroll magically reveals the locations of nearby loose change to you.

ITEM_OBJECT_DETECTION.name: Object Detection
ITEM_OBJECT_DETECTION.flavorText: This scroll shows nearby objects to you. It only makes you aware of items on the floor, however, not those carried by creatures.

ITEM_SHEAF_ARROW.name: & Sheaf Arrow~
ITEM_SHEAF_ARROW.flavorText: These arrows have bigger arrowheads and bigger feathers. They also make bigger holes.

ITEM_MITHRIL_SHOT.name: & Mithril Shot~
ITEM_MITHRIL_SHOT.flavorText: Sling bullets made from the slags of mithril smelting. They are unusually heavy, hitting with great force, and are almost imperishable.

ITEM_DOOR_STAIR_LOCATION.name: Door/Stair Location
ITEM_DOOR_STAIR_LOCATION.flavorText: When fuelled with enough ambient mana, this rod can detect nearby passages.

ITEM_ACQUIREMENT.name: *Acquirement*
ITEM_ACQUIREMENT.flavorText: Several great treasures have been hidden in a magical compartment. This scroll serves as the key and will release them when read.

ITEM_MASS_GENOCIDE.name: Mass Genocide
ITEM_MASS_GENOCIDE.flavorText: An astoundingly powerful death spell is stored in the runes of this spell.  Reading it will annihilate all nearby creatures. Only a few beings of legendary stature can withstand it.

ITEM_DETECT_INVISIBLE.name: Detect Invisible
ITEM_DETECT_INVISIBLE.flavorText: This magical concoction will temporarily improve your eyesight so that you can see creatures otherwise unseen.

ITEM_ARTIFACT_CREATION.name: Artifact Creation
ITEM_ARTIFACT_CREATION.flavorText: The mighty magic on this scroll will imbue a mundane item you possess with supernatural powers, also rendering the object indestructible.

ITEM_RECHARGING.name: Recharging
ITEM_RECHARGING.flavorText: This scroll is inscribed with a spell releasing the enchantments used to give wands and staves their power, allowing you to replenish their spent charges.

ITEM_GENOCIDE.name: Genocide
ITEM_GENOCIDE.flavorText: A standard Genocide from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_DARKNESS.name: Darkness
ITEM_DARKNESS.flavorText: This scroll will create a blast of utter darkness, which then fades to leave the immediate surroundings in a lasting gloom. The extreme darkness can blind those who are not used to it.

ITEM_PROTECTION_FROM_EVIL.name: Protection from Evil
ITEM_PROTECTION_FROM_EVIL.flavorText: Upon reading the runes on this piece of paper, a faint aura of holiness will spring into existence around you, protecting you from blows of evil creatures, unless they are more powerful than you.

ITEM_SATISFY_HUNGER.name: Satisfy Hunger
ITEM_SATISFY_HUNGER.flavorText: Reading this scroll will transport a good portion of nourishing gruel directly into your stomach. Some people say that this is a ploy of a food producer whose food nobody wants to eat.

ITEM_DISPEL_UNDEAD.name: Dispel Undead
ITEM_DISPEL_UNDEAD.flavorText: A powerful exorcism is inscribed on this scroll. When read it will hurt undead abominations nearby, possibly even destroying them.

ITEM_ENCHANT_WEAPON.name: *Enchant Weapon*
ITEM_ENCHANT_WEAPON.flavorText: Reading this scroll will magically infuse a weapon of your choice, making it more effective in combat.

ITEM_CURSE_WEAPON.name: Curse Weapon
ITEM_CURSE_WEAPON.flavorText: This scroll will ruin your weapon beyond repair. Only weapons of legend have a hope of escaping destruction, but even they will often be shattered.

ITEM_CURSE_ARMOUR.name: Curse Armour
ITEM_CURSE_ARMOUR.flavorText: This scroll bears a curse that will tear your armour to shreds. Don't read it!

ITEM_SUMMON_UNDEAD.name: Summon Undead
ITEM_SUMMON_UNDEAD.flavorText: These spells scribed by ancient necromancers will call their horrible creatures to haunt you.

ITEM_BLESSING.name: Blessing
ITEM_BLESSING.flavorText: The recitation of this scroll will grant you a blessing of the Valar, making you more confident in attack and defence for a few moments.

ITEM_HOLY_CHANT.name: Holy Chant
ITEM_HOLY_CHANT.flavorText: This blessing will give you a holy warrior's prowess in battle for a while.

ITEM_HOLY_PRAYER.name: Holy Prayer
ITEM_HOLY_PRAYER.flavorText: This incantation lets you fight as a warrior of Valinor for quite a while, supreme in attack and defence.

ITEM_WORD_OF_RECALL.name: Word of Recall
ITEM_WORD_OF_RECALL.flavorText: The spell on this scroll will slowly build an ethereal conduit to the town for you if you are in a dungeon, and into the dungeon if you are above ground. Upon completion, which takes a while, you will suddenly be translocated to the other place.

ITEM_DESTRUCTION.name: *Destruction*
ITEM_DESTRUCTION.flavorText: This scroll is inscribed with a mighty conjuration which wrecks the dungeon all around you. Monsters and objects will be annihilated by this blast; only completely indestructible things can withstand it.

ITEM_SLIME_MOLD_JUICE.name: Slime Mold Juice
ITEM_SLIME_MOLD_JUICE.flavorText: A strange sort of yellowish-green slime, too viscous to even slosh in the bottle. And as I know you, you're going to slurp it down.

ITEM_WATER.name: [Water]
ITEM_WATER.flavorText: A large gem, filled with dark blue water. It feels strangely heavy and cold.

ITEM_RESTORE_INTELLIGENCE.name: Restore Intelligence
ITEM_RESTORE_INTELLIGENCE.flavorText: This beneficial potion will magically heal your brain, restoring drained intelligence.

ITEM_WISDOM.name: Wisdom
ITEM_WISDOM.flavorText: This magical amulet will magically make you wiser, and fend off attacks that would reduce your wisdom. Beware: if cursed, the amulet will do the opposite.

ITEM_RESTORE_WISDOM.name: Restore Wisdom
ITEM_RESTORE_WISDOM.flavorText: This potion benefits the naive, bringing back their wisdom to what it once was.

ITEM_UGLINESS.name: Ugliness
ITEM_UGLINESS.flavorText: This wicked potion slightly twists your features, making you appear less fair.

ITEM_RESTORE_CHARISMA.name: Restore Charisma
ITEM_RESTORE_CHARISMA.flavorText: This useful potion restores drained charm.

ITEM_CURING.name: Curing
ITEM_CURING.flavorText: This is a rod with minor healing powers, alleviating many disabling conditions.

ITEM_INVULNERABILITY.name: Invulnerability
ITEM_INVULNERABILITY.flavorText: This immensely powerful potion makes your physique almost indestructible for a very short time. Very rarely, an attempt to hurt you will still succeed, so don't be too confident.

ITEM_NEW_LIFE.name: New Life
ITEM_NEW_LIFE.flavorText: This potion fundamentally twists your physical features, as if you were another mother's child. Your physique will be shaped anew.

ITEM_CURE_CRITICAL_WOUNDS.name: Cure Critical Wounds
ITEM_CURE_CRITICAL_WOUNDS.flavorText: This nice potion will cure a good bit of hurt you have suffered and also allows you to recover from unhealthy conditions like blood poisoning, confusion or blindness.

ITEM_HEALING.name: *Healing*
ITEM_HEALING.flavorText: This highly desirable potion will greatly help recovering from wounds, typically healing you fully.

ITEM_EXPERIENCE.name: Experience
ITEM_EXPERIENCE.flavorText: This exceptional drink instills into you knowledge, allowing you to advance further in your trade.

ITEM_SLEEP.name: Sleep
ITEM_SLEEP.flavorText: This potion was made to help people with bad sleeping disorders to find rest. Surely you don't want to take a nap while nasty goblins are searching for you?

ITEM_BOOZE.name: Booze
ITEM_BOOZE.flavorText: A small bottle of a dark brown distilled beverage. By its look and smell, it contains a fair amount of still muck and wood alcohol.

ITEM_SLOWNESS.name: Slowness
ITEM_SLOWNESS.flavorText: A magical concoction which drains force from you, forcing you to move and act a lot slower, until it wears off.

ITEM_RESTORE_DEXTERITY.name: Restore Dexterity
ITEM_RESTORE_DEXTERITY.flavorText: This magical brew brings your agility back to its former glory should it have been reduced.

ITEM_LOSE_MEMORIES.name: Lose Memories
ITEM_LOSE_MEMORIES.flavorText: A wicked potion, making you less of an adventurer than by right you should be.

ITEM_SALT_WATER.name: Salt Water
ITEM_SALT_WATER.flavorText: A solution of salt in water, made for curing meat. Drinking it would cause violent nausea.

ITEM_ENLIGHTENMENT.name: *Enlightenment*
ITEM_ENLIGHTENMENT.flavorText: This magical concoction will grant you great insight, magically improving your wits and wisdom, letting you know precisely who and where you are and what you possess.

ITEM_HEROISM.name: Heroism
ITEM_HEROISM.flavorText: Quaffing this drink will temporarily make you fight like a hero of great might.

ITEM_BERSERK_STRENGTH.name: Berserk Strength
ITEM_BERSERK_STRENGTH.flavorText: This strange drink will instill in you a wild battle rage for a while.

ITEM_BOLDNESS.name: Boldness
ITEM_BOLDNESS.flavorText: This drink will improve your courage, dispelling all fear.

ITEM_RESTORE_LIFE_LEVELS.name: Restore Life Levels
ITEM_RESTORE_LIFE_LEVELS.flavorText: If your life force has been drained, this blessed brew will bring it back.

ITEM_RESIST_HEAT.name: Resist Heat
ITEM_RESIST_HEAT.flavorText: This magical potion will make fire flow in your veins, rendering you less vulnerable to outward heat.

ITEM_RESIST_COLD.name: Resist Cold
ITEM_RESIST_COLD.flavorText: This magical potion will for a short while grant you a familiarity with frost, so that you take less harm from extreme cold.

ITEM_SLOW_POISON.name: Slow Poison
ITEM_SLOW_POISON.flavorText: This healthy potion will dilute poisons in your blood.

ITEM_NEUTRALISE_POISON.name: Neutralise Poison
ITEM_NEUTRALISE_POISON.flavorText: This powerful antidote will completely negate the effect of poisons currently affecting you.

ITEM_RESTORE_MANA.name: Restore Mana
ITEM_RESTORE_MANA.flavorText: This potion infuses the drinker with pure magic force, bringing their magical potential back to its full extent.

ITEM_INFRA_VISION.name: Infra-vision
ITEM_INFRA_VISION.flavorText: This potion temporarily grants or improves the ability to optically perceive heat sources.

ITEM_RESISTANCE.name: Resistance
ITEM_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This amulet will make the wearer resist the elements.

ITEM_MANATHRUST.name: Manathrust
ITEM_MANATHRUST.flavorText: A standard Manathrust from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_FIREFLASH.name: Fireflash
ITEM_FIREFLASH.flavorText: A standard Fireflash from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_FIREWALL.name: Firewall
ITEM_FIREWALL.flavorText: A standard Firewall from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_TIDAL_WAVE.name: Tidal Wave
ITEM_TIDAL_WAVE.flavorText: A standard Tidal Wave from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_ICE_STORM.name: Ice Storm
ITEM_ICE_STORM.flavorText: A standard Ice Storm from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_NOXIOUS_CLOUD.name: Noxious Cloud
ITEM_NOXIOUS_CLOUD.flavorText: A standard Noxious Cloud from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_POISON_BLOOD.name: Poison Blood
ITEM_POISON_BLOOD.flavorText: A standard Poison Blood from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_THUNDERSTORM.name: Thunderstorm
ITEM_THUNDERSTORM.flavorText: A standard Thunderstorm from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_DIG.name: Dig
ITEM_DIG.flavorText: A standard Dig from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_STONE_PRISON.name: Stone Prison
ITEM_STONE_PRISON.flavorText: A standard Stone Prison from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_STRIKE.name: Strike
ITEM_STRIKE.flavorText: A standard Strike from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_TELEPORT_AWAY.name: Teleport Away
ITEM_TELEPORT_AWAY.flavorText: A standard Teleport Away from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_SUMMON_ANIMAL.name: Summon Animal
ITEM_SUMMON_ANIMAL.flavorText: A standard Summon Animal from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_MAGELOCK.name: Magelock
ITEM_MAGELOCK.flavorText: A standard Magelock from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_SLOW_MONSTER.name: Slow Monster
ITEM_SLOW_MONSTER.flavorText: This obstructive rod emits an energy bolt which will slow the creature it hits.

ITEM_ESSENCE_OF_SPEED.name: Essence of Speed
ITEM_ESSENCE_OF_SPEED.flavorText: A standard Essence of Speed from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_BANISHMENT.name: Banishment
ITEM_BANISHMENT.flavorText: A standard Banishment from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_DISPERSE_MAGIC.name: Disperse Magic
ITEM_DISPERSE_MAGIC.flavorText: A standard Disperse Magic from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_CHARM.name: Charm
ITEM_CHARM.flavorText: A standard Charm from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_CONFUSE.name: Confuse
ITEM_CONFUSE.flavorText: A standard Confuse from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_DEMON_BLADE.name: Demon Blade
ITEM_DEMON_BLADE.flavorText: A standard Demon Blade from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_HEAL_MONSTER.name: Heal Monster
ITEM_HEAL_MONSTER.flavorText: A standard Heal Monster from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_HASTE_MONSTER.name: Haste Monster
ITEM_HASTE_MONSTER.flavorText: A standard Haste Monster from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_FLIGHT_ARROW.name: & Flight Arrow~
ITEM_FLIGHT_ARROW.flavorText: An arrow designed for longer flight. Consequently, it is lighter and hits with less force.

ITEM_BOULDER.name: & Boulder~
ITEM_BOULDER.flavorText: A big nasty-looking piece of rock.

ITEM_NECROMANTIC_TEETH.name: & Necromantic Teeth~
ITEM_NECROMANTIC_TEETH.flavorText: This looks like some animal's teeth or at least you think it comes from an animal...

ITEM_SPELL.name: Spell
ITEM_SPELL.flavorText: This amulet is a container for spells. Those that are skilled in copying spells can inscribe a spell into it.

ITEM_NOTHING.name: Nothing
ITEM_NOTHING.flavorText: A standard Nothing from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_GLOBE_OF_LIGHT.name: Globe of Light
ITEM_GLOBE_OF_LIGHT.flavorText: A standard Globe of Light from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_FIERY_SHIELD.name: Fiery Shield
ITEM_FIERY_SHIELD.flavorText: A standard Fiery Shield from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_REMOVE_CURSES.name: Remove Curses
ITEM_REMOVE_CURSES.flavorText: A standard Remove Curses from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_WINGS_OF_WINDS.name: Wings of Winds
ITEM_WINGS_OF_WINDS.flavorText: A standard Wings of Winds from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_SHAKE.name: Shake
ITEM_SHAKE.flavorText: A standard Shake from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_PROBABILITY_TRAVEL.name: Probability Travel
ITEM_PROBABILITY_TRAVEL.flavorText: A standard Probability Travel from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_RECOVERY.name: Recovery
ITEM_RECOVERY.flavorText: A standard Recovery from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_VISION.name: Vision
ITEM_VISION.flavorText: A standard Vision from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_SENSE_HIDDEN.name: Sense Hidden
ITEM_SENSE_HIDDEN.flavorText: A standard Sense Hidden from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_REVEAL_WAYS.name: Reveal Ways
ITEM_REVEAL_WAYS.flavorText: A standard Reveal Ways from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_SENSE_MONSTERS.name: Sense Monsters
ITEM_SENSE_MONSTERS.flavorText: A standard Sense Monsters from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_SUMMON.name: Summon
ITEM_SUMMON.flavorText: A standard Summon from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_STERILIZATION.name: Sterilization
ITEM_STERILIZATION.flavorText: A standard Sterilization from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_WISH.name: Wish
ITEM_WISH.flavorText: A standard Wish from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_MANA.name: [Mana]
ITEM_MANA.flavorText: A large gem that seems somehow immaterial and is filled with a strange insubstantial... power?

ITEM_TOME_OF_MAGICAL_ENERGY.name: & Tome~ of Magical Energy
ITEM_TOME_OF_MAGICAL_ENERGY.flavorText: The bright blue cover of this tome seems to glow with an inner violet light. You feel more attuned to raw magic as you hold it.

ITEM_TOME_OF_THE_ETERNAL_FLAME.name: & Tome~ of the Eternal Flame
ITEM_TOME_OF_THE_ETERNAL_FLAME.flavorText: The cover of this tome is bright red, with flickering flames dancing across it once in a while. As you hold it, you begin to gain a much closer knowledge of all that is fiery.

ITEM_TOME_OF_THE_BLOWING_WIND.name: & Tome~ of the Blowing Wind
ITEM_TOME_OF_THE_BLOWING_WIND.flavorText: The pages of this tome have a tendency to turn themselves, as though flipped by an errant wind. As you hold it, you start feeling wind at your fingertips.

ITEM_TOME_OF_THE_IMPENETRABLE_EARTH.name: & Tome~ of the Impenetrable Earth
ITEM_TOME_OF_THE_IMPENETRABLE_EARTH.flavorText: The solid leather cover of this tome seems permanently stained with caked mud and grass. Heavy it is to lift, yet strangely comforting to hold - you feel stronger and better supported.

ITEM_TOME_OF_THE_EVERRUNNING_WAVE.name: & Tome~ of the Everrunning Wave
ITEM_TOME_OF_THE_EVERRUNNING_WAVE.flavorText: The cover and pages of this tome seem to be perpetually wet, though they are not wet to the touch. As you hold it, you begin to understand ocean storms better.

ITEM_TOME_OF_TRANSLOCATION.name: & Tome~ of Translocation
ITEM_TOME_OF_TRANSLOCATION.flavorText: This book seems to flicker strangely. It's one of those books with an annoying tendency to disappear when you need it and reappear in the unlikeliest places. As you hold it, you start to understand what conveyance really means.

ITEM_TOME_OF_THE_TREE.name: & Tome~ of the Tree
ITEM_TOME_OF_THE_TREE.flavorText: The cover of this tome is a bright shade of green, and it gives off a healthy, zesty scent that makes your thoughts clearer. As you hold it, your heart goes out to all living things upon Arda.

ITEM_TOME_OF_KNOWLEDGE.name: & Tome~ of Knowledge
ITEM_TOME_OF_KNOWLEDGE.flavorText: A thick book with solid leather binding. It looks entirely unremarkable, but as you hold it, you feel strangely able to learn the inner workings of things and creatures.

ITEM_IRON_SPIKE.name: & Iron Spike~
ITEM_IRON_SPIKE.flavorText: A small spur of iron. Ramming one between a door and its frame might jam it.

ITEM_WOODEN_TORCH.name: & Wooden Torch~
ITEM_WOODEN_TORCH.flavorText: A piece of wood with an oily rag wrapped around it. When lit, it will give off a little light and much smoke.

ITEM_BRASS_LANTERN.name: & Brass Lantern~
ITEM_BRASS_LANTERN.flavorText: A brass container with a wick emerging from it, protected from draughts by a sheet of greased paper. It can be carried by a handle.

ITEM_FLASK_OF_OIL.name: & Flask~ of oil
ITEM_FLASK_OF_OIL.flavorText: A small clay container, filled with thick oil. The oil is flammable and can be used as lantern fuel.

ITEM_EMPTY_BOTTLE.name: & Empty Bottle~
ITEM_EMPTY_BOTTLE.flavorText: A small glass bottle. It's empty.

ITEM_HAVOC.name: Havoc
ITEM_HAVOC.flavorText: This powerful rod will release great blasts of destructive energy, but there's no knowing what this effect will concentrate on.

ITEM_RECALL.name: Recall
ITEM_RECALL.flavorText: A rod which can transport you from the depths to your home and back.

ITEM_ILLUMINATION.name: Illumination
ITEM_ILLUMINATION.flavorText: This rod carries a minor spell of brightness, lighting your immediate surroundings whenever activated.

ITEM_LIGHTNING_BOLTS.name: Lightning Bolts
ITEM_LIGHTNING_BOLTS.flavorText: This rod shoots a small spark of lightning, zapping the creature it hits.

ITEM_FROST_BOLTS.name: Frost Bolts
ITEM_FROST_BOLTS.flavorText: A small but extremely cold shard of ice will fly from this rod to your enemy.

ITEM_FIRE_BOLTS.name: Fire Bolts
ITEM_FIRE_BOLTS.flavorText: This rod fires a magical flaming arrow at your foe, burning it.

ITEM_POLYMORPH.name: Polymorph
ITEM_POLYMORPH.flavorText: This rod of change will cause its target creature to mutate into something else.

ITEM_SLEEP_MONSTER.name: Sleep Monster
ITEM_SLEEP_MONSTER.flavorText: This sorcerous rod will cause its target to stop in its tracks.

ITEM_DRAIN_LIFE.name: Drain Life
ITEM_DRAIN_LIFE.flavorText: This necromantic magical rod will hurt a living creature struck by its spell.

ITEM_TELEPORT_OTHER.name: Teleport Other
ITEM_TELEPORT_OTHER.flavorText: This rod of movement will displace its target to another location.

ITEM_LIGHTNING_BALLS.name: Lightning Balls
ITEM_LIGHTNING_BALLS.flavorText: This rod will hurl a large ball of lightning at its target, electrifying all it engulfs.

ITEM_COLD_BALLS.name: Cold Balls
ITEM_COLD_BALLS.flavorText: This rod will call forth a minor storm of ice which freezes everything in the area of its blast.

ITEM_FIRE_BALLS.name: Fire Balls
ITEM_FIRE_BALLS.flavorText: This rod will cause a small storm of flame to rage in a small circular area of your choice.

ITEM_ACID_BALLS.name: Acid Balls
ITEM_ACID_BALLS.flavorText: This destructive rod will drown its target and its immediate surroundings in caustic acid.

ITEM_ACID_BOLTS.name: Acid Bolts
ITEM_ACID_BOLTS.flavorText: This rod will shoot a small glob of powerful acid at its target.

ITEM_DETECTION.name: Detection
ITEM_DETECTION.flavorText: This rod grants knowledge about all things worthy of notice in your vicinity.

ITEM_RESTORATION.name: Restoration
ITEM_RESTORATION.flavorText: This rod lets you remember your previous abilities and gain them back, should they have been reduced.

ITEM_BROKEN_SKULL.name: & Broken Skull~
ITEM_BROKEN_SKULL.flavorText: Good old Yorick. So that's where he ended up.

ITEM_BROKEN_BONE.name: & Broken Bone~
ITEM_BROKEN_BONE.flavorText: A yellowish bone, broken off. Obviously, its owner no longer has a use for it.

ITEM_RODENT_SKELETON.name: & Rodent Skeleton~
ITEM_RODENT_SKELETON.flavorText: The remains of a cat's meal.

ITEM_DWARF_SKELETON.name: & Dwarf Skeleton~
ITEM_DWARF_SKELETON.flavorText: The remains of a dwarf who met his or her demise here.

ITEM_ELF_SKELETON.name: & Elf Skeleton~
ITEM_ELF_SKELETON.flavorText: A person of about human shape, but considerably more slightly built, has died here long ago.

ITEM_GNOME_SKELETON.name: & Gnome Skeleton~
ITEM_GNOME_SKELETON.flavorText: This was once a gnome. Looks very dead now.

ITEM_GREAT_HAMMER.name: & Great Hammer~
ITEM_GREAT_HAMMER.flavorText: A massive smith's hammer, so large and heavy it can be used as a weapon.

ITEM_BLACK_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Black Dragon Scale Mail~
ITEM_BLACK_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: An armour made of a black dragon's hide, containing some of this beast's powers.

ITEM_BLUE_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Blue Dragon Scale Mail~
ITEM_BLUE_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A piece of dragon hide fashioned into an armour, shimmering bright blue.

ITEM_WHITE_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & White Dragon Scale Mail~
ITEM_WHITE_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: An armour fashioned from dragon hide, glistening the white of snow.

ITEM_RED_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Red Dragon Scale Mail~
ITEM_RED_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: The skin of a dragon made into a suit of armour. It glows a bright red and radiates heat.

ITEM_GREEN_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Green Dragon Scale Mail~
ITEM_GREEN_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of armour fashioned of dragon hide. It is dirty green and smells awful.

ITEM_MULTI_HUED_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Multi-Hued Dragon Scale Mail~
ITEM_MULTI_HUED_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A powerful armour made of dragonhide. It glows red, blue, green, black and white.

ITEM_PSEUDO_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Pseudo Dragon Scale Mail~
ITEM_PSEUDO_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of armour made of dragon hide, glowing with a strange light, or is it darkness?

ITEM_LAW_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Law Dragon Scale Mail~
ITEM_LAW_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A piece of dragonhide cut and shaped so it can be worn as armour. The scales are very sharp, and the roaring of a storm seems to come from it, but you're not afraid of either.

ITEM_BRONZE_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Bronze Dragon Scale Mail~
ITEM_BRONZE_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of armour made from dragon skin. Its brownish scales glitter in a dazzling light.

ITEM_GOLD_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Gold Dragon Scale Mail~
ITEM_GOLD_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of golden-hued armour made of dragonhide. The rustle of its scales occasionally increases to a loud boom.

ITEM_CHAOS_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Chaos Dragon Scale Mail~
ITEM_CHAOS_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of armour made of dragon hide. It glows in colours you have never seen before. As you put it on, you feel like you could change the world and are no longer afraid of your equipment losing its magic.

ITEM_BALANCE_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Balance Dragon Scale Mail~
ITEM_BALANCE_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of armour made of the hide of a dead dragon. When wearing it, you feel like you understand the principles of law and chaos, and no longer fear either.

ITEM_POWER_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.name: & Power Dragon Scale Mail~
ITEM_POWER_DRAGON_SCALE_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of armour made of a very thick richly coloured dragonhide. You think you'll never have to fear dragons if you put it on.

ITEM_DRAGON_HELM.name: & Dragon Helm~
ITEM_DRAGON_HELM.flavorText: An iron helmet, covered with a layer of dragonhide. It offers great protection and may grant protection against some dragon's attacks, based on the dragon the hide was taken from.

ITEM_DRAGON_SHIELD.name: & Dragon Shield~
ITEM_DRAGON_SHIELD.flavorText: A large shield, with a dragonskin cover. Depending on which dragon the hide came from, it might grant protection against some sorts of dragon breath.

ITEM_DEATH.name: Death
ITEM_DEATH.flavorText: A potent and very quickly working poison, sometimes utilised by those who wish to end their lives. It is immensely toxic and will seriously hurt you even if you just get some of it on your hands.

ITEM_RUINATION.name: Ruination
ITEM_RUINATION.flavorText: This wicked potion will seriously damage your abilities beyond the powers of magical restoration.

ITEM_DETONATIONS.name: Detonations
ITEM_DETONATIONS.flavorText: This bottle is filled with a strange substance which will violently explode if strongly agitated. You don't want to know what it might do to your intestines.

ITEM_AUGMENTATION.name: Augmentation
ITEM_AUGMENTATION.flavorText: This blessed potion will greatly improve all your abilities, if they can still be improved.

ITEM_LIFE.name: Life
ITEM_LIFE.flavorText: This wonderful potion will fully heal you no matter how badly you're hurt, allow drained abilities to recover and remove various other ailments.

ITEM_FEAR_RESISTANCE.name: Fear Resistance
ITEM_FEAR_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This ring grants courage, so that you can never become afraid.

ITEM_LIGHT_AND_DARKNESS_RESISTANCE.name: Light and Darkness Resistance
ITEM_LIGHT_AND_DARKNESS_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This ring protects against fluctuations of the light.

ITEM_NETHER_RESISTANCE.name: Nether Resistance
ITEM_NETHER_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This blessed ring improves your life force, protecting you from the draining forces of nether and other attempts to suck your lifeblood.

ITEM_NEXUS_RESISTANCE.name: Nexus Resistance
ITEM_NEXUS_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This ring of stability protects you from the warping forces of nexus.

ITEM_SOUND_RESISTANCE.name: Sound Resistance
ITEM_SOUND_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This ring projects an aura of quiet around you, protecting you from loud noise.

ITEM_CONFUSION_RESISTANCE.name: Confusion Resistance
ITEM_CONFUSION_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This ring stabilises your mind, protecting you from all kinds of befuddlement.

ITEM_SHARD_RESISTANCE.name: Shard Resistance
ITEM_SHARD_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This piece of jewellery magically toughens your skin, protecting you from flying shrapnel.

ITEM_DISENCHANTMENT_RESISTANCE.name: Disenchantment Resistance
ITEM_DISENCHANTMENT_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This rare ring of preservation protects your equipment from attempts to sap its magic, also causing you to suffer less pain from such attacks.

ITEM_CHAOS_RESISTANCE.name: Chaos Resistance
ITEM_CHAOS_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This ring protects you from the horribly warping forces of chaos.

ITEM_BLINDNESS_RESISTANCE.name: Blindness Resistance
ITEM_BLINDNESS_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This ring magically preserves your eyesight, making you impervious to any attempt to blind you.

ITEM_LORDLY_PROTECTION.name: Lordly Protection
ITEM_LORDLY_PROTECTION.flavorText: This blessed ring will protect you from disenchantment, poison, attempts to drain your life force and holding magic.

ITEM_EXTRA_ATTACKS.name: Extra Attacks
ITEM_EXTRA_ATTACKS.flavorText: This powerful ring of fighters greatly enhances your fighting speed, allowing you to attack more often in a round of combat.

ITEM_CURE_LIGHT_WOUNDS.name: Cure Light Wounds
ITEM_CURE_LIGHT_WOUNDS.flavorText: This healthy drink heals a little damage you have taken.

ITEM_CLUMSINESS.name: Clumsiness
ITEM_CLUMSINESS.flavorText: This nasty concoction will numb your nerves, making you clumsier.

ITEM_SICKLINESS.name: Sickliness
ITEM_SICKLINESS.flavorText: This unhealthy drink damages your health, reducing your physical constitution.

ITEM_SILVER_ARROW.name: & Silver Arrow~
ITEM_SILVER_ARROW.flavorText: An arrow to be shot with a bow, its iron head coated with hallowed silver, a material that sears the flesh of all evil creatures.

ITEM_SILVER_BOLT.name: & Silver Bolt~
ITEM_SILVER_BOLT.flavorText: This crossbow bolt has a silver tip, blessed by the Valar for fighting evil.

ITEM_LIGHTNING_RESISTANCE.name: Lightning Resistance
ITEM_LIGHTNING_RESISTANCE.flavorText: This amulet will protect you from electrical discharges and storms.

ITEM_REGENERATION.name: Regeneration
ITEM_REGENERATION.flavorText: Wearing this amulet will trigger your body's regenerational processes quicker and make them proceed faster.

ITEM_INFRAVISION.name: Infravision
ITEM_INFRAVISION.flavorText: This amulet will increase your ability to sense warm-blooded creatures in your vicinity. Beware: if cursed, it will do just the opposite.

ITEM_DEVOTION.name: Devotion
ITEM_DEVOTION.flavorText: This blessed amulet will protect your wisdom and charms from diminishing, often adding to them as well. It also grants some extra protective magics by the grace of the Valar.

ITEM_WEAPONMASTERY.name: Weaponmastery
ITEM_WEAPONMASTERY.flavorText: The ultimate amulet for a warrior, it will grant protection in the face of some evil magics, protect your strength and health, also increasing them. Beware: if cursed, the amulet will sap your strength and health instead.

ITEM_TRICKERY.name: Trickery
ITEM_TRICKERY.flavorText: The ultimate amulet for a rogue or assassin, it protects the wearer against some evil magics, granting improvements in the abilities vital to these adventurers. Beware: if cursed, the amulet will do just the opposite.

ITEM_TELEPATHY.name: Telepathy
ITEM_TELEPATHY.flavorText: This rare and powerful amulet lays bare the minds of monsters before the wearer.

ITEM_SUSTENANCE.name: Sustenance
ITEM_SUSTENANCE.flavorText: This blessed amulet will make the wearer impervious to evil magics that would sap innate abilities. It also slows down the digestive system, making food less necessary on long journeys.

ITEM_PALANTIR.name: & Palantir~
ITEM_PALANTIR.flavorText: A standard & Palantir~ from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_ELFSTONE.name: & Elfstone~
ITEM_ELFSTONE.flavorText: A standard & Elfstone~ from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_JEWEL.name: & Jewel~
ITEM_JEWEL.flavorText: A standard & Jewel~ from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_RING.name: & Ring~
ITEM_RING.flavorText: A standard & Ring~ from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_COPPER.name: copper
ITEM_COPPER.flavorText: A standard copper from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_SILVER.name: silver
ITEM_SILVER.flavorText: A standard silver from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_GARNETS.name: garnets
ITEM_GARNETS.flavorText: A standard garnets from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_GOLD.name: gold
ITEM_GOLD.flavorText: A standard gold from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_OPALS.name: opals
ITEM_OPALS.flavorText: A standard opals from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_SAPPHIRES.name: sapphires
ITEM_SAPPHIRES.flavorText: A standard sapphires from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_RUBIES.name: rubies
ITEM_RUBIES.flavorText: A standard rubies from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_DIAMONDS.name: diamonds
ITEM_DIAMONDS.flavorText: A standard diamonds from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_EMERALDS.name: emeralds
ITEM_EMERALDS.flavorText: A standard emeralds from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_MITHRIL.name: mithril
ITEM_MITHRIL.flavorText: A standard mithril from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_ADAMANTITE.name: adamantite
ITEM_ADAMANTITE.flavorText: A standard adamantite from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_MIGHTY_HAMMER.name: & Mighty Hammer~
ITEM_MIGHTY_HAMMER.flavorText: A standard & Mighty Hammer~ from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_MASSIVE_IRON_CROWN.name: & Massive Iron Crown~
ITEM_MASSIVE_IRON_CROWN.flavorText: A standard & Massive Iron Crown~ from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_PHIAL.name: & Phial~
ITEM_PHIAL.flavorText: A standard & Phial~ from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_STAR.name: & Star~
ITEM_STAR.flavorText: A standard & Star~ from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_ARKENSTONE.name: & Arkenstone~
ITEM_ARKENSTONE.flavorText: A standard & Arkenstone~ from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_AMULET.name: & Amulet~
ITEM_AMULET.flavorText: A standard & Amulet~ from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_NECKLACE.name: & Necklace~
ITEM_NECKLACE.flavorText: A standard & Necklace~ from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_REFLECTION.name: Reflection
ITEM_REFLECTION.flavorText: This wondrous amulet will magically make the wearer reflect arrows and bolts launched by adversaries.

ITEM_ANTI_MAGIC.name: Anti-Magic
ITEM_ANTI_MAGIC.flavorText: This amulet wards off magic of any kind, good or bad.

ITEM_ANTI_TELEPORTATION.name: Anti-Teleportation
ITEM_ANTI_TELEPORTATION.flavorText: This amulet will prevent the space-time continuum from being disrupted around the wearer.

ITEM_ZWEIHANDER.name: & Zweihander~
ITEM_ZWEIHANDER.flavorText: This great sword of foreign origin is approximately 6 feet long. The hilt is long enough for even four hands to grip. A mighty weapon for a warrior.

ITEM_SPLINT_MAIL.name: & Splint Mail~
ITEM_SPLINT_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of metal armour that consists of metal strips applied vertically to the backing of chain, leather, or cloth.

ITEM_TRIFURCATE_SPEAR.name: & Trifurcate Spear~
ITEM_TRIFURCATE_SPEAR.flavorText: This deadly spear's point has three branches, suited for inflicting greater damage than a regular spear.

ITEM_THREE_PIECE_ROD.name: & Three Piece Rod~
ITEM_THREE_PIECE_ROD.flavorText: A descendant of the threshing flail, consisting of three short wooden pieces linked by chain or rope.

ITEM_FUR_CLOAK.name: & Fur Cloak~
ITEM_FUR_CLOAK.flavorText: A coat made from the fur of various wild animals - it is somewhat bulky, but still spacious enough to wear over armour.

ITEM_WATER_CURING.name: Water Curing
ITEM_WATER_CURING.flavorText: It is a magical component that can purify water.

ITEM_HATCHET.name: & Hatchet~
ITEM_HATCHET.flavorText: This is a large axe that could be wielded in one or two hands.  It has a single blade with a pick on the reverse, designed for armour piercing.

ITEM_RHINO_HIDE_ARMOUR.name: & Rhino Hide Armour~
ITEM_RHINO_HIDE_ARMOUR.flavorText: A hard leather armour made from the thick hide of a rhinoceros.

ITEM_LEATHER_JACKET.name: & Leather Jacket~
ITEM_LEATHER_JACKET.flavorText: A garment fashioned from animal hide, resembling a robe that has been shortened to waist-length, with straight-cut sleeves and a bit of decorative fringe around the collar.

ITEM_SICKLE.name: & Sickle~
ITEM_SICKLE.flavorText: A semicircular blade attached to a short handle, good for chopping things up into pieces.

ITEM_CLUB.name: & Club~
ITEM_CLUB.flavorText: A stout heavy stick, thicker at one end. Useful for shattering and smashing things.

ITEM_BROAD_SPEAR.name: & Broad Spear~
ITEM_BROAD_SPEAR.flavorText: Designed specifically for foot soldiers combatting cavalry, this spear is too heavy to be effective when thrown.

ITEM_KHOPESH.name: & Khopesh~
ITEM_KHOPESH.flavorText: This sword comes from the regions of Far Harad. The blade is straight for 18 inches, and then it curves for another 2 feet.

ITEM_FLAMBERGE.name: & Flamberge~
ITEM_FLAMBERGE.flavorText: A large, two-handed sword with a blade that weaves left and right until it reaches the hilt.

ITEM_CLAYMORE.name: & Claymore~
ITEM_CLAYMORE.flavorText: Also known as a Claidhmore, or Greatsword, this weapon is favoured by powerful mercenaries. The blade is large, straight, and broad, almost as large as a two-handed sword.

ITEM_ESPADON.name: & Espadon~
ITEM_ESPADON.flavorText: This is the strictly two-handed version of the bastard sword. The blade is of medium length, double-edged, and considerably heavy to wield.

ITEM_GREAT_SCIMITAR.name: & Great Scimitar~
ITEM_GREAT_SCIMITAR.flavorText: This is a larger version of the curved oriental blade. Runes of war decorate its golden hilt.

ITEM_FAUCHARD.name: & Fauchard~
ITEM_FAUCHARD.flavorText: It is a type of glaive with two ornate hooks on the back of the blade. It is typically 8 to 9 feet long.

ITEM_GUISARME.name: & Guisarme~
ITEM_GUISARME.flavorText: Mounted on a long shaft for maximum reach, this weapon is effective at repelling both cavalry and infantry.

ITEM_HEAVY_LANCE.name: & Heavy Lance~
ITEM_HEAVY_LANCE.flavorText: This is a shock weapon. Its purpose is to unhorse a rider in single combat, or smash through the armour of opposing lines.

ITEM_BASILARD.name: & Basilard~
ITEM_BASILARD.flavorText: This is a two-edged dagger with a long blade. A favourite among travellers and warriors alike, it can be worn comfortably with plain clothes as well as armour.

ITEM_RING_MAIL.name: & Ring Mail~
ITEM_RING_MAIL.flavorText: A suit of non-overlapping metal rings sewn onto a heavy leather backing.

ITEM_CORD_ARMOUR.name: & Cord Armour~
ITEM_CORD_ARMOUR.flavorText: Fibres of hemp or other natural material woven and knotted into a thick, tough fabric.

ITEM_PAPER_ARMOUR.name: & Paper Armour~
ITEM_PAPER_ARMOUR.flavorText: Thickly pleated sheets of paper assembled together into a suit of armour.

ITEM_PADDED_ARMOUR.name: & Padded Armour~
ITEM_PADDED_ARMOUR.flavorText: Heavy, multi-layered cloth sewn together to cover the body, with extra padding between layers.

ITEM_STONE_AND_HIDE_ARMOUR.name: & Stone and Hide Armour~
ITEM_STONE_AND_HIDE_ARMOUR.flavorText: A primitive armour made from a thick hide reinforced by stone shards.

ITEM_BLOOD_OF_LIFE.name: & Blood~ of Life
ITEM_BLOOD_OF_LIFE.flavorText: Quaffing this measure of living blood will imbue your body and soul with the power to escape death one time.

ITEM_MAGE_STAFF.name: & Mage Staff~
ITEM_MAGE_STAFF.flavorText: It looks like a simple walking stick, plain and nondescript. In the hands of a spellcaster, it can be a deadly weapon.

ITEM_LIGHTNING.name: Lightning
ITEM_LIGHTNING.flavorText: This sparkling circlet grants you protection, makes electricity less dangerous and even allows you to call forth a ball of lightning.

ITEM_INVISIBILITY.name: Invisibility
ITEM_INVISIBILITY.flavorText: This magical bauble will hide you from sight.

ITEM_CORRUPTION.name: Corruption
ITEM_CORRUPTION.flavorText: This concoction of toxic wastes will strangely warp your shape.

ITEM_DEEP_THOUGHTS.name: Deep Thoughts
ITEM_DEEP_THOUGHTS.flavorText: This parchment contains the thoughts of a powerful wizard who departed Middle-earth long ago.

ITEM_MORE_DEEP_THOUGHTS.name: More Deep Thoughts
ITEM_MORE_DEEP_THOUGHTS.flavorText: This parchment contains the thoughts of a powerful wizard who departed Middle-earth long ago.

ITEM_COMPENDIUM_OF_DEEP_THOUGHTS.name: Compendium of Deep Thoughts
ITEM_COMPENDIUM_OF_DEEP_THOUGHTS.flavorText: This parchment contains the thoughts of a powerful wizard who departed Middle-earth long ago.

ITEM_ARTIFACT_LORE_VOL_I.name: Artifact Lore Vol. I
ITEM_ARTIFACT_LORE_VOL_I.flavorText: This parchment contains information about unique artifacts that are rumoured to exist upon Arda.

ITEM_ARTIFACT_LORE_VOL_II.name: Artifact Lore Vol. II
ITEM_ARTIFACT_LORE_VOL_II.flavorText: This parchment contains information about unique artifacts that are rumoured to exist upon Arda.

ITEM_ARTIFACT_LORE_VOL_III.name: Artifact Lore Vol. III
ITEM_ARTIFACT_LORE_VOL_III.flavorText: This parchment contains information about unique artifacts that are rumoured to exist upon Arda.

ITEM_MORPHIC_OIL_OF.name: & Morphic Oil~ of #
ITEM_MORPHIC_OIL_OF.flavorText: This concoction can transform your body for a short period of time.

ITEM_.flavorText: Combined with proper skill, this cloak can make you seem like a different creature. Otherwise, it just provides some extra protection.

ITEM_CORPSE.name: corpse
ITEM_CORPSE.flavorText: Whatever happened with this one, it wasn't pretty.

ITEM_SKELETON.name: skeleton
ITEM_SKELETON.flavorText: The sorry, bony remains of some hapless creature.

ITEM_HEAD.name: head
ITEM_HEAD.flavorText: 2 eyes, 2 ears, a mouth, some hair -- yep, that's a head.

ITEM_SKULL.name: skull
ITEM_SKULL.flavorText: It's a white bony skull, smiling to you without teeth.

ITEM_RAW_MEAT.name: raw meat
ITEM_RAW_MEAT.flavorText: Yuck, just looking at it makes your stomach upset.

ITEM_THUNDERLORD_COAT.name: & Thunderlord Coat~
ITEM_THUNDERLORD_COAT.flavorText: This suit of thick impregnated cloth is worn by the riders of flying steeds, and protects them from extremes of temperatures.

ITEM_SMALL_WOODEN_BOOMERANG.name: & Small Wooden Boomerang~
ITEM_SMALL_WOODEN_BOOMERANG.flavorText: A small curved piece of wood.

ITEM_WOODEN_BOOMERANG.name: & Wooden Boomerang~
ITEM_WOODEN_BOOMERANG.flavorText: A strange, curved leaf-shaped piece of wood.

ITEM_SMALL_METAL_BOOMERANG.name: & Small Metal Boomerang~
ITEM_SMALL_METAL_BOOMERANG.flavorText: A short boomerang with metal blades on the "forward" edges.

ITEM_METAL_BOOMERANG.name: & Metal Boomerang~
ITEM_METAL_BOOMERANG.flavorText: A strange curved leaf-shaped piece of wood, its "forward" edges enhanced with metal blades.

ITEM_SUMMON_NEVER_MOVING_PET.name: Summon Never-Moving Pet
ITEM_SUMMON_NEVER_MOVING_PET.flavorText: A piece of paper, inscribed with runes which will summon an immobile creature to your aid.

ITEM_CURE_LIGHT_INSANITY.name: Cure Light Insanity
ITEM_CURE_LIGHT_INSANITY.flavorText: A magical potion which drives away irrational quirks of behaviour.

ITEM_CURE_SERIOUS_INSANITY.name: Cure Serious Insanity
ITEM_CURE_SERIOUS_INSANITY.flavorText: A magical brew which will lift shadows that have been cast on your soul.

ITEM_CURE_CRITICAL_INSANITY.name: Cure Critical Insanity
ITEM_CURE_CRITICAL_INSANITY.flavorText: This drink will cure you even of serious mental disorders.

ITEM_CURE_INSANITY.name: Cure Insanity
ITEM_CURE_INSANITY.flavorText: This blessed potion can make you completely sane and healthy, even if you have only the faintest shred of sanity left.

ITEM_RANDOM_ARTIFACT.name: Random Artifact
ITEM_RANDOM_ARTIFACT.flavorText: A standard Random Artifact from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_CRAFTSMANSHIP.name: Craftsmanship
ITEM_CRAFTSMANSHIP.flavorText: A powerful scroll, desired by many, as it can magically improve the special powers of magical weaponry.

ITEM_HORN.name: & Horn~
ITEM_HORN.flavorText: A simple wind instrument made from brass. If used by inexperienced musicians it sounds like somebody making "prbbt!" noises down a drainpipe.

ITEM_DRUM.name: & Drum~
ITEM_DRUM.flavorText: A sort of clay pot with a bit of skin stretched over its mouth.

ITEM_HARP.name: & Harp~
ITEM_HARP.flavorText: A number of strings held by a wooden frame.

ITEM_EGG.name: Egg
ITEM_EGG.flavorText: A standard Egg from the depths of ToME.

ITEM_RESET_RECALL.name: Reset Recall
ITEM_RESET_RECALL.flavorText: A strange formula is inscribed on this scroll, which allows you to define another place as the location to which recalls shall move you.

ITEM_DIVINATION.name: Divination
ITEM_DIVINATION.flavorText: This scroll is inscribed with a ritual which allows you to discern what fate holds in store for you.

ITEM_SPRIG_OF_ATHELAS.name: & Sprig~ of Athelas
ITEM_SPRIG_OF_ATHELAS.flavorText: 'When the black breath blows / And death's shadow grows / And all lights pass / Come Athelas! Come Athelas! / Life to the dying / In the King's hands lying.'

ITEM_OLD_SCROLL_OF_DEINCARNATION.name: & Old Scroll~ of Deincarnation
ITEM_OLD_SCROLL_OF_DEINCARNATION.flavorText: It allows you to leave your body to reincarnate into another one. However, your current body is lost in the process.

ITEM_DARK_SWORD.name: & Dark Sword~
ITEM_DARK_SWORD.flavorText: A strange, very sharp long sword, which seems to drain light from its surroundings. As you wield it, you feel much less attuned to magic.

ITEM_NUMENOREAN_FOR_BEGINNERS_I.name: Numenorean for Beginners (I)
ITEM_NUMENOREAN_FOR_BEGINNERS_I.flavorText: These ancient words still contain magic.

ITEM_NUMENOREAN_FOR_BEGINNERS_II.name: Numenorean for Beginners (II)
ITEM_NUMENOREAN_FOR_BEGINNERS_II.flavorText: These ancient words still contain magic.

ITEM_ADVANCED_LESSONS_OF_NUMENOREAN.name: Advanced Lessons of Numenorean
ITEM_ADVANCED_LESSONS_OF_NUMENOREAN.flavorText: These ancient words still contain magic.

ITEM_ADVANCED_LESSONS_OF_SINDARIN.name: Advanced Lessons of Sindarin
ITEM_ADVANCED_LESSONS_OF_SINDARIN.flavorText: These ancient words still contain magic.

ITEM_SHARD_OF_POTTERY.name: & Shard~ of Pottery
ITEM_SHARD_OF_POTTERY.flavorText: Half a clay jar -- how many failed artists have taken refuge in these dungeons?

ITEM_BOOK_OF_BEGINNER_CANTRIPS.name: & Book~ of Beginner Cantrips
ITEM_BOOK_OF_BEGINNER_CANTRIPS.flavorText: The blood smudged on the cover makes you wonder how many people had it before you...

ITEM_BOOK_OF_TELEPORTATION.name: & Book~ of Teleportation
